acceptance: Predeclared held-out encoder RMSE <=3 counts AND final displacement error <=5 counts per pulse; otherwise flag this model as insufficient. Not a physical calibration confidence interval.
interpretation: Empirical encoder-displacement fit over measured PWM sweeps. Held-out errors determine validity per trial. Does not separately identify physical R/L/Ke/Kt/inertia/friction or certify maximum speed.
split: Train individual positive PWM 25/100/300/500/700/900. Hold out all reverse pulses, other positive duties, and every concurrent pulse. Timing perturbation covers serialization window only, not unknown internal sample age.
weights: One encoder count plus observed peak speed times half the request/reply window; descriptive scale, not a calibrated noise standard deviation. Each pulse has equal aggregate weight.
